title: Cyrus and the Confession
author: Edmund Crane
blurb: Mirabel Kavanagh, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
